_comment: Priors for the Surprise step. expected = proportion (0-1). Every expected value needs a citation (PMID/DOI/URL) and a comparability label (CLAUDE.md rule 6). CDC values derived from NHANES keep note 'pipeline check'. TODO(Brau): fill expected, source and comparability; leave null until cited.

expectations.statement: Total diabetes (diagnosed, or HbA1c >= 6.5%) among US adults

source.citation: CDC National Diabetes Statistics Report, Appendix A: Detailed Tables (NHANES 2017-March 2020), Table 1, total diabetes, 13.2% (95% CI 12.0-14.5)

expectations.comparability: partial: CDC is age-adjusted, adults >= 18, diagnosed or HbA1c >= 6.5 or fasting glucose >= 126; ours is crude, adults >= 20 not pregnant, HbA1c only; CDC years overlap our discovery cycle J

expectations.statement: Undiagnosed diabetes (reports no diagnosis, HbA1c >= 6.5%) among US adults

source.citation: CDC National Diabetes Statistics Report, Appendix A: Detailed Tables (NHANES 2017-March 2020), Table 1, undiagnosed diabetes, 3.1% (95% CI 2.6-3.8)

expectations.comparability: partial: CDC is age-adjusted, adults >= 18, HbA1c >= 6.5 or fasting glucose >= 126 without reported diagnosis; ours is crude, adults >= 20 not pregnant, HbA1c only; CDC years overlap our discovery cycle J

expectations.statement: Prediabetes by HbA1c (5.7-6.4%) among adults without diagnosed diabetes

source.citation: CDC National Diabetes Statistics Report, Appendix A: Detailed Tables (NHANES 2017-March 2020), Table 5, prediabetes definition 1, 36.5% (95% CI 34.2-38.8)

expectations.comparability: low: CDC is age-adjusted, all adults >= 18 including diagnosed diabetes, HbA1c 5.7-6.4 or fasting glucose 100-125; ours is crude, adults >= 20 reporting no or borderline diagnosis, HbA1c only; CDC years overlap our discovery cycle J
